scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client "npm run build:watch -w @monopoly/shared" "npm run dev -w @monopoly/server" "npm run dev -w @monopoly/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @monopoly/shared && npm run build -w @monopoly/server && npm run build -w @monopoly/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @monopoly/shared && npm run lint -w @monopoly/server && npm run lint -w @monopoly/client
